title: Awesome item, horrible packaging
text: Awesome item, horrible packaging. As another reviewer from September '01 posted, the packaging is horrid.  Literally 4 items thrown in a box with no protection at all other than a super thin plastic "bag" over each horn. One of my horns had fallen out of it's packaging and was scratched.  The other two bags had holes and rips in them.  I can't figure out if they were reused or just got that beat up in the box.  It's a miracle one or all of the horns wasn't chipped. Other than missing 50 cents worth of packaging modifications, fantastic item at a great price...assuming they arrive usable.
